name: Iori
message: 「No way, to think the very first match I support would be between two members of Takamura Class...」
Right now, Setsugekka and Asahi are facing each other right before my eyes.
I did say that sometimes classmates from Takamura Class would end up clashing in the qualifiers... but to have it happen right out of the gate is something else.
...And on top of that, right next to me is.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, I wonder who's gonna win? This is gonna be fun!」

name: Iori
message: 「...Why are you here, Ririmu?」
Even though I'd just sent her off with so much encouragement.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nah, well, truth is, I went there, but it's not even close to my turn yet.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, I was bored just sitting around, and I figured I’d scout the competition!」

name: Iori
message: 「You really do move at your own pace, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Obviously! I’m the one who decides my own pace!」
Well, maybe it’s less nerve-wracking than watching alone.

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, Teach, who do you think is gonna win？」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s hard to guess... or rather, if I had my way, I’d want both of them to win！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, that’s impossible. It’s a match, so one’s gonna win and the other’s gonna lose.」

name: Iori
message: 「I know that, but... dammit, this is tough！」
Having seen how hard everyone in Takamura Class has been working, just imagining the sadness of the one who loses makes my chest ache.

name: Iori
message: 「...Alright！ I don't know who will win, but I'm going to go encourage whoever loses！」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll leave the winner to you, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, you’re dumping a weird job on me！」

name: Iori
message: 「Just treat them to some kind words as my stand-in. Honestly, just having someone to talk to would be enough.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fine, fine, leave it to me. You really are a softhearted teacher, aren't you?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But when I win, you better be the one to show me some appreciation, okay？」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, as long as it's not a match between Takamura Class members.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... you’re not soft there, huh? You really don't budge.」
That's my pride as a teacher, so I can't help it.

name: Iori
message: 「Truth is, I wanted to be the Second for everyone. But... things like this happen.」
A Second can only support one of the two participants in a match.
However, if I were to support, say, only Setsugekka or only Asahi, it would come across as favoritism.
After much thought, I decided to unify my stance by stating that I couldn't be a Second for anyone.

name: Ririmu
message: 「It’s not like I really need a Second or anything～」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you sure? Couldn't you have asked one of the students from the Technical Division to be your Second, Ririmu?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, well, that girl specializes in smithing, y'know～。 She’s not really the type who can chime in with advice during a match.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Plus, there’s nobody else who can support us as accurately as you can, Teach.」
When I asked the others, they all gave me the same answer as Ririmu just did.
Because of that, the end result was that everyone in the Takamura Class competed in the Martial Festival without a Second.

name: Umpire
message: 「Both combatants, take your stances！」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh... looks like it's about to start.」
At the Umpire's voice, the two facing each other quietly take their stances, and the tension spikes instantly.
Both Ririmu and I hold our breath—

name: Umpire
message: 「...Begin！」
At last, the battle has begun.
Right up until the signal to start, I had been nervous.
The atmosphere and the sheer intensity were completely different from our usual practice matches.
I felt all of that pressing down on me, and I was anxious about whether I could perform as I intended.
But as soon as it began, all of that was blown away in an instant.
Perhaps that is because—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I come, Asahi-chan！」

name: Asahi
message: （Perhaps it’s thanks to Setsugekka-san charging in just as she always does.）
Setsugekka-san lunges forward with tremendous momentum.
Gauging her speed and the distance—the moment she enters my range, I strike！

name: Asahi
message: 「Haaaah！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa...！ That won't hit me！」
Setsugekka-san dodged the first strike with surprising ease.
And immediately, she closes the distance once more.
This was something that hadn't happened before. But—

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s not over yet！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa！？」
I instantly reverse my blade and deliver a second strike.
Although she managed to block it, Setsugekka-san retreated once because of it.
In that time, I sheath my sword and reset my stance.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That surprised me... I thought I’d be good once I dodged the first one.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Come to think of it, I don't think I've shown you this much. It would be a big mistake to think of Iai as just a one-trick pony.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「If you're fighting Asahi-chan, you wouldn't think that. But wow, you really have a lot of techniques.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes. Moreover—the Iai draw isn't just about waiting for an opening！」
This time, I won't wait for Setsugekka-san to approach—I'll take the offensive！
No holding back. I've won before and I'm confident now, but I won't be careless.
Give it my all, use every tactic, and win decisively！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Coming from you...！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You mustn't let your guard down！」
I dash in and slash my blade the moment I enter range.
Though the tip of my blade caught Setsugekka-san, she managed to dodge at the very last second.
It looked like she was trying to put some distance between us—but I won't let her escape！

name: Asahi
message: 「Second strike—！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaaaah！」
Stepping forward to cut off her path, I unleash a second, upward-slashing strike.
This one landed. I could feel the distinct sensation of my blade shaving through her Barrier Jacket.
However—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm not planning on backing down！」
Despite taking damage, Setsugekka-san didn't flinch, instead stepping in to strike at my momentary opening.
A low stance, moving with fierce speed as if sliding across the ground. I have to get into a defensive posture—！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Mishima-ryuu Type Kanoe, Gouhou！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ghuuuuuh...!」
A strike launched diagonally from below—
It had enough power to pierce my guard, scrape my Barrier Jacket, and lift my body into the air.
Gritting my teeth at the unpleasant feeling of having no ground beneath my feet, I see Setsugekka-san closing in to follow up.

name: Asahi
message: 「In that case...！」
Left with no choice, I drew my blade while still sliding through the air to drive her back.
I figured even a strike without a firm stance would at least buy me those precious few seconds until I landed, but—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「―Mishima―ryuu Type Tsuchinoto, Tenzankou！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Akkhhh！？」
Setsugekka-san sank her body as if turning her back to me, slipping under my slash to ram into me with her shoulder and back.
I was sent flying before I could even land, crashing straight into the wall.

name: Asahi
message: 「Guh, ugh...！ You really are a walking weapon...！」
Savoring the feel of the ground finally beneath my feet, I endure the pain and lift my face.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'll finish this in one go！！」
Setsugekka-san sprints toward me to press her attack.
However, I have already finished sheathing my blade—！

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you really think... I'll let you do that?！」
From my crouched stance, I use the momentum of rising to unleash an upward slashing counter from below！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ghh...？！ Playing dead？！」
With terrifying reflexes, Setsugekka-san barely managed to dodge it.
It only grazed her body, failing to deal any major damage.
Still, her advance was halted, and her stance broke. In that case, now it's my turn！

name: Asahi
message: 「I am certainly not dead！！」
My follow-up strike—yet Setsugekka-san managed to catch it, however narrowly.
With our blades still locked, Setsugekka-san smiles at me right before my eyes.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「This is so fun, Asahi-chan！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe... It certainly is.」
I return her smile—though deep down, this was no situation to be smiling in.
Setsugekka-san has clearly grown stronger than before. She is no longer an opponent I can defeat with ease.
Still, I don't think my calculations were off. I knew from the start that Setsugekka-san would grow tremendously.

name: Asahi
message: （Setsugekka-san isn't the only one who has grown. I, too, have been receiving Sensei's guidance all this time...！）
From the wings of the stage, I feel Iori―sensei's gaze―

name: Asahi
message: （Please keep watching, Iori-sensei. The me who has grown stronger through your guidance...！）

name: Asahi
message: 「Haaaaah！」
Knocking my blade aside from the lock, Asahi-chan drives straight in with a strike.
Even with her blade already drawn, her swings are fast and heavy—just blocking each blow is a struggle.
On top of that, last time, even when I struggled to close in, she immediately shook me off, and I lost without ever getting into my own range.

name: Setsugekka
message: （But it's different now！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Right there！！」
Weaving through the openings in Asahi-chan's attacks, I drive in a strike.
It missed, but I don't care.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I won't let you get away！」
The moment I sense Asahi-chan trying to pull back, I preempt her by keeping her in check with an Origami.
In that opening, I step in again and rain down a flurry of blows！

name: Setsugekka
message: （I can move, I can fight！ I'm growing stronger, Sensei！）
Being able to feel that for myself made me happy.
Thanks to Sensei's guidance, I've gotten way stronger than before！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hraaaaaaah！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Too slow！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kyaaah！」
Just as I tried to move, Asahi-chan’s attack came flying in, catching me in a counter.

name: Setsugekka
message: （I guess I can't just keep being happy about this...！）
I’ve definitely become stronger. I can tell that much clearly now.
But it’s the same for Asahi-chan. If anything, she was strong from the start, and now she’s even more polished.
If I wait until I see the attack coming, my defenses and evasions aren’t fast enough to keep up.
So, I have no choice but to predict her moves and act first—

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s about time... I’ll show you my full power！！」
I manage to catch two of her attacks. And the next one is—

name: Setsugekka
message: （The next one is probably... right！）
I think that and brace my defenses.
But in that instant, Asahi-chan’s body leaned ever so slightly to the left.

name: Setsugekka
message: （The other way...！？ I have to defend！）

name: Asahi
message: 「You’re naive—Secret Art, Ouitsu Issen！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Guaaaaaah...！？」
The secret art, laced with a feint, was truly ferocious.
With no time to dodge, I took it head-on. I managed to regain my stance while rolling across the ground.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hah, hah... that one really got me...！」
Since my style relies mostly on intuition, it’s incredibly tough when a skilled fighter like Asahi-chan uses fakes.
With that last blow, my Barrier Jacket is down to about a fifth. From here on out, if I get hit even once more, I’m finished.
This is bad... if it keeps going like this, I’m going to lose...！

name: Setsugekka
message: （I don’t want that... I don't want to lose！ Sensei is watching, too, so I can’t lose here！）
Just as I thought that—I felt Mizuchi stir deep within me.
『I understand well... I do not wish to lose to anyone...！ Who could ever admit that they are inferior...！』
I felt as if I’d heard a voice. That voice threw words at me, as if carving them into my mind.
『I will not lose to the likes of Asahi here... I will show Sensei, and everyone else, the greatness of my own power...！！』
It was vanity, it was pride―something dark and murky that couldn’t be described with pretty words―
『I want to win, I want to be recognized, I want to be needed...！ I want to be above everyone else, I am stronger than anyone...！！』
It was jealousy, and it was arrogance.
It wasn’t about being a swordsman, or about the Kazamine name. It was a prideful, swelling desire to look good in front of Sensei.
It was rising up within me, accompanied by anger.
――Ah, this is the sign of a berserk state.
If I just let my emotions take over like this, I'll end up entrusting everything to Mizuchi again.

name: Setsugekka
message: （No... that's not right...！）
Until now, I had been pushing it away. I was desperately trying to keep it from entering me.
But, I recall what Sensei said once more.
Who am I, what do I desire, and why, for what purpose do I live?

name: Setsugekka
message: （I am a Kazamine, and I am the younger sister of the person I respect, Kei-chan）
But that's not all.

name: Setsugekka
message: （I have to fight Momimomi, and I have to win）
But that's not all.

name: Setsugekka
message: （I am... I am...）
When I was little, I smiled even though I didn't want to. Because I had to.
But now――？

name: Setsugekka
message: （That's right... I'm already much stronger than I was back then. Not just in Jindou. My body and my heart have grown stronger too）
So, I'm okay now. I should be able to accept it.
This is what I have hidden deep in the darkness. A part of me that has been inside me all along.
I can feel it overflowing from the bottom of the darkness. It is circulating through my entire body, trying to seep into me.
It doesn't matter. I can accept this darkness now—this black, raging emotion that has become a 'dwelling for the Keyou'.
The vanity, the jealousy, the arrogance. Everything is within me.

name: Setsugekka
message: （That's right, Mizuchi is me. This is 'me'――！！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa... hah, hah, fuuuu...！！」
Something changed inside me.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I see... this is the real me, isn't it？」
There is no one to answer that question.
But I felt like I had finally arrived at the true answer――.
I stopped mid-stride, about to pursue Setsugekka-san as she stumbled from the damage.
Something happened right before my eyes. That much was certain.

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, you...」
As if answering my call, Setsugekka-san opens her eyes, which had been closed, and gazes at me.
Her presence is completely different.
While carrying the same aura as when she was berserk, it is something quieter and stronger.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Asahi-chan... I don't want to lose.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I want to show Sensei that I can do well, I want to be praised by him, and I want everyone to say that I'm amazing.」
She speaks to me just like the usual Setsugekka. There is none of that savagery present when she loses control.
And that is precisely why I understood—

name: Asahi
message: （Ah... this is bad...！）
My skin crawls. My sixth sense is blaring its maximum alarm.
The person standing before me is a completely different being from a moment ago. I must recognize this: she is a grave threat.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Oosode Myouga！」
I deploy my Barrier Jacket, making it hard and thick, donning an invisible suit of armor—
This is a defensive technique I devised with Iori-sensei previously.
I drastically shift the allocation of my Tenju, pouring everything into defense and speed. This makes the Oosode Myouga even more robust.
A thorough, absolute defensive posture. My offensive power is sacrificed, but that doesn't matter.
If I don't, there's no way I can possibly stand against her—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I come, Asahi-chan.」
She lunges at me with a speed that is utterly unbelievable, completely unlike her tone, which has remained unchanged.
It's not just like a bullet; it’s like a flash of lightning. If I were acting normally, it would have been difficult even to follow her with my eyes—but.

name: Asahi
message: 「Now, I can follow you！」
I unleash a draw-cut aiming for a counter. But it is caught by Setsugekka's gauntlet.
She stops dead from that speed and defends herself calmly. That alone is enough to leave me astonished, but—

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah！」
After a momentary deadlock, Setsugekka twists her body to parry my blade, then immediately delivers a roundhouse kick.
Though I manage to block it thanks to the deployed Oosode Myouga, the impact makes my body slide backward.
Setsugekka closes in on me again.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pushing through！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I won't let you...！」
For the first strike, Setsugekka parried my counter; for the next, I blocked Setsugekka's slash.
However, both times, I was pushed back by Setsugekka's blade.
Perhaps because I've completely abandoned my offense, I'm losing the clash of strength. It is unbearably frustrating.

name: Asahi
message: （At this rate, eventually...！）

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Still, we're just getting started！」
Setsugekka increases her speed further and closes the distance.
She’s forced her way into a distance where a striking battle is unavoidable, with no room to draw my sword, so I hastily assume a defensive posture.
A slash aimed at me just as I try to pull away from the close―quarters strikes―
It’s a sequence of attacks I’m familiar with, yet in the face of Setsugekka-san’s current speed and power, it becomes an unsettlingly massive threat.
Whether I evade or parry, the next attack comes flying in immediately, and I’m forced to keep closing the distance without a single opening to counterattack.
For the attacks I can't fully avoid, I have no choice but to block them with Oosode Myouga, but that won't last long.

name: Asahi
message: （Changing the allocation of my Tenju was the right call... If I didn't have the speed, I couldn't keep up; if I didn't have the defense, I couldn't block.）
Though, even specializing in those, it’s a stalemate at best—or perhaps Setsugekka-san still has the upper hand.
I went from being the one pursued to the one doing the pursuing in the blink of an eye.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaah…！ Mishima-ryuu Type Kou: Edanagi！！！」
I dodge the strike and take her side-kick aimed at my torso. The impact reverberates even through my Oosode Myouga, and my face contorts involuntarily.
Can I actually beat an opponent like this...？
Even if I give my all and exhaust every strategy, I’m nowhere near a guaranteed victory. That is how much of a threat Setsugekka-san is right now.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haaaaaaah！」

name: Asahi
message: 「That doesn’t mean… I have any intention of losing！」
A full-power blow connects, and it’s—Setsugekka-san who is sent staggering back.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ow… Asahi-chan, you could strike too！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Unlike with a drawn blade, Iai leaves both my hands free. It’s my secret weapon for when I can’t perform a draw-cut.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I see. So then… I guess it’s a striking battle now？」
Setsugekka-san smiles as if she’s having fun. Meanwhile, I return a self-deprecating, bitter smile.

name: Asahi
message: 「If you ask why it’s a secret weapon, it’s because it’s nothing more than a one-trick pony, just punching with raw strength.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I don’t expect something like this to work twice on Setsugekka-san, who has truly mastered martial arts.」
As I say that, I fix my gaze on Setsugekka-san once more.
If I don't prioritize defense, I can't endure it. But conversely, even if I do, I still can't endure it.
Then, the only thing I must do to win is.

name: Asahi
message: 「...This is the only thing that will work on you now, Setsugekka-san.」
I take my stance. Deeper, and stronger than ever before.
I shift the Tenju I had allocated to defense and speed back into attack. No, more than that—I am using everything for the sake of an attack now.
I pour all my power into the Origami, charging it up—！

name: Setsugekka
message: 「In that case—I’m going all out too.」
Setsugekka-san begins gathering her power as well.
I know that stance. A finishing move that once even destroyed the arena wall.
Yet right now, the pressure I feel surpasses even that. Its power has probably grown even greater than back then—

name: Asahi
message: （Who cares！ I'll settle this right here！）
Setsugekka-san makes her move. I immediately respond in kind.
A single flash, infused with all of my spiritual power.
I drive that flash home！！

name: Asahi
message: 「Secret Technique: Raitei Issen！！！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mishima-ryuu Type Mizunoto: Banzetsu！！！！」
—I felt a flash of lightning and an impact strong enough to turn the world upside down.
Was I standing or had I fallen? Which way was I even facing? I completely lost track of what state I was in.
After a while, though, once it finally subsided, the sensation of pain returned to my body.

name: Umpire
message: 「That's enough！！」
My hearing must have come back too, because I started to hear cheers.
At the same time, a loud, booming voice rang out—

name: Umpire
message: 「...Winner, Kazamine Setsugekka！！！」
